description: Compute the future value of a principal plus an optional recurring contribution under compound interest, given an annual rate (as a percent), a term in years, and a compounding frequency (periods per year), plus a year-by-year balance breakdown.

annualRatePercent.description: Annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 5

compoundsPerYear.description: Compounding periods per year, e.g. 1 = annually, 12 = monthly, 365 = daily

contributionPerPeriod.description: Optional recurring contribution made at the end of each compounding period

name: calculate_compound_interest
